name: following-pointer
blurb: Custom pointer with label follows cursor within a bounded area.
description: Card wrapper that hides the native cursor and renders a custom pointer icon with optional label that tracks mouse movement. Uses motion/react for enter/exit animations.
use_when: Interactive cards where a custom cursor adds polish and guides attention during hover.
avoid_when: Touch-only surfaces or devices without pointer events.
a11y: Custom cursor hides the native one with no keyboard fallback. Title is optional text content.
